text: Confirmed: `required=True` on a boolean flag (`--on/--off`) is ignored because the flag's default value short-circuits the missing-value check. A fix is in progress; I'll report when it's verified.

Confirmed: click's stream helpers assume `sys.stdout`/`sys.stderr`/`sys.stdin` are real streams, so under `pythonw.exe` (where they are `None`) `echo`, the progress bar and the pager all crash with AttributeError. A fix is in progress; I'll report when it's verified.
Confirmed: for a flag-like option defined with `flag_value`, an envvar is currently used as the raw value instead of acting as a boolean switch. A fix is in progress; I'll report when it's verified.
Confirmed: the decorator reuses a single parameter instance, so only the first command it decorates gets your custom `cls`. A fix is in progress; I'll report when verified.
Confirmed: resolving a symlink with a relative target joins it against the wrong base, so you get a path relative to the cwd. A fix is in progress; I'll report when verified.
Confirmed: the `show_default` help text only looks at the option's own default and ignores the default map. A fix is in progress; I'll report when verified.
